description: MADISON – Congressman Mark Pocan will hold a town hall forum this week to discuss the hot topics of the day and preview the upcoming 2018 elections. This is an opportunity for people to discuss both public policy and campaign strategy with their Congressman, as we get ready for next year’s state and federal elections. […]
